617:t_117:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ will fight you! Because...!」

617:t_117:10.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ will fight you! Because...!」

617:t_117:12.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「That is $$ノノ$$'s role!」

617:t_117:13.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「That is $$ノノ$$'s role!」

617:t_117:14.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will shatter it! Prepare yourself, warrior who inherited the civilization of fire's legacy!!」

617:t_118:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_118:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Are you playing Zen riddles at this point? Or trying to find yourself?」

617:t_118:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Answer me, inheritor of the blood of the beast.」

617:t_118:3.en:
$$葵$$
「I don't owe you an answer. ...Or rather, I've never thought about it.」

617:t_118:4.en:
$$葵$$
「So I'll tell you how I feel now! I fight to keep guys I can't stand, like you, from throwing their weight around!」

617:t_118:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That will do. Come at me with your primal instincts.」

617:t_118:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will beat beasts into submission with power! With this power of mine!」

617:t_118:7.en:
$$葵$$
「Don't talk about me like I'm a stray dog! I'll make you pay for those words, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

617:t_119:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_119:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Why do you fight for that?」

617:t_119:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「It doesn't matter whether you're a soldier or an office worker! Each of us does what we can for peace!」

617:t_119:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「In my case, that's fighting in $$ダイ・ガード$$!!」

617:t_119:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So you're an office worker who protects peace...」

617:t_119:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But before me, status and titles are meaningless! Just show me your own power!」

617:t_120:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_120:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I love freedom above all. I can only stand firm against those who obstruct it.」

617:t_120:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Having heard that, I need no further words.」

617:t_120:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...I wanted to talk with you, including about $$ガイオウ$$, but it seems that's impossible.」

617:t_120:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You seem to use words as weapons, but for now, you'll follow my way.」

617:t_120:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Now...! Show me your power this time!」

617:t_120:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm accustomed to handling people like this. Though I would rather not be.」

617:t_120:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$! Then $$ビッグオー$$ and I will face you on your terms!」

617:t_121:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_121:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I fight to punch out bastards like you, acting all high and mighty and smashing other people's happiness!」

617:t_121:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You're quite crude for someone who pilots a Mechanical Angel.」

617:t_121:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then you're pretty damn smug for a $$次元将$$!」

617:t_121:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am myself. Whatever may happen.」

617:t_121:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「For that very reason, you will offer me your power!」

617:t_121:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Like hell I'll let you have your way! Let's fight, $$次元将$$!」

617:t_122:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_122:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I fight to defeat guys like you who act like rulers and take away people's happiness!」

617:t_122:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You're quite weak for someone who pilots a Mechanical Angel.」

617:t_122:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's true I don't have power like $$アポロ$$ or $$カグラ$$! But there's something I won't lose to anyone in!」

617:t_122:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And what is that?」

617:t_122:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's my love for $$ミコノ$$!」

617:t_122:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You are quite a man...」

617:t_122:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well! Then show me that love!」

617:t_122:8.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You don't have to tell me! Here I come, $$次元将$$!!」

617:t_123:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_123:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「If you cannot answer, begone. I have no use for such people.」

617:t_123:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「That's how... people like you just ignore how we feel and force things on us...」

617:t_123:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「It's wrong for someone like that to do whatever they want with the world!」

617:t_123:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So you, too, are a warrior...」

617:t_123:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well! I acknowledge you as a man worthy of fighting me!」

617:t_124:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_124:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I fight for peace, for the future...」

617:t_124:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Above all, I fight for $$ティファ$$!!」

617:t_124:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You come at me without a trace of doubt, driven by those feelings...!」

617:t_124:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I acknowledge your battle! And you will offer me that power!」

617:t_124:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Shut up! You have no right to say a damn thing about my feelings for $$ティファ$$!」

617:t_124:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Here I come, $$ヴィルダーク$$! I'll beat you and end this battle!!」

617:t_125:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_125:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I fight for the people living in this world!」

617:t_125:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Can you fight for something so abstract?」

617:t_125:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Someone who can speak of life that way doesn't deserve the title of Emperor!」

617:t_125:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Someone who can't feel the people living in the world mustn't rule it!」

617:t_125:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...Perhaps you are right.」

617:t_125:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I'll fight as a general, rather than an emperor! That is how I live!!」

617:t_126:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_126:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I want to see where humanity goes... I fight to remove those who stand in its way.」

617:t_126:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even though you yourself are a forerunner?」

617:t_126:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There's only so much one person can do. All of humanity moves toward the future.」

617:t_126:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So I'll protect that...! That's my battle!」

617:t_126:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I will strike you down!」

617:t_126:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I do so recognizing you as one of this universe's greatest warriors, rather than to halt humanity's evolution!」

617:t_127:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_127:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I fight to protect life!」

617:t_127:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That's a small reason for one whose power is rare even in the universe.」

617:t_127:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A man who calls the existence of life small...!」

617:t_127:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ヴィルダーク$$! You must not be allowed to exist!」

617:t_127:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I cannot stop...! For the lives I have taken, too!」
